description.en: Original generic geological-form analog of valley glacier informed by NPS Fraser Glacier photograph and valley-versus-piedmont explanation. Not Fraser Glacier reconstruction, exact DEM, current retreat/melting chronology or assigned prehistoric period/ecosystem. Illustrative nominal900x1600x350m landscape, ice width roughly250m, no exact site measurement. Continuous full volume ice surface visible above valley floor, side bedrock rises higher. Crevasses shallow subordinate relief, not deep cuts severing tongue.
